definitions.gloss: shortest, minimum (in distance, time, or length)
definitions.explanation: The superlative of short — the least in distance, duration, or length among a group. Commonly used for routes, time periods, and records.

examples.japanese: {最短|さいたん}ルートで{行|い}く。
examples.english: To go by the shortest route.

examples.japanese: {最短|さいたん}で{三日|みっか}かかります。
examples.english: It will take three days at the minimum.

examples.japanese: {目的地|もくてきち}までの{最短|さいたん}{距離|きょり}をナビで{調|しら}べてから{出発|しゅっぱつ}した。
examples.english: I checked the shortest distance to the destination on the GPS before leaving.

notes:
USAGE:
{最短|さいたん} functions as a noun or の-adjective. It applies to distance, time, and length.
- Distance: {最短|さいたん}ルート (shortest route), {最短|さいたん}{距離|きょり} (shortest distance)
- Time: {最短|さいたん}で〜 (at the earliest / minimum time)
- Records: {最短|さいたん}{記録|きろく} (shortest record)

When used adverbially with で, it means "at the earliest" or "at a minimum" in terms of time.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {最短|さいたん}{距離|きょり}: shortest distance
- {最短|さいたん}ルート: shortest route
- {最短|さいたん}{記録|きろく}: shortest record
- {最短|さいたん}で: at the earliest, at minimum
